description: INFORMATION_SCHEMA.POLICY_REFERENCES - the readback surface every policy attachment shares, and the only one that shows a row access or aggregation policy at all (DESCRIBE's policy name cell answers for masking policies alone). The measured split: a policy attached to a COLUMN fills REF_COLUMN_NAME and leaves REF_ARG_COLUMN_NAMES null, while one attached to the OBJECT does the reverse and renders its argument columns as a spaced JSON array. Several attachments come back together ordered by policy name, a view is its own domain, the domain is matched case-insensitively, the policy-name call shape lists every object a policy reaches, and each refusal (neither argument shape, half a pair, missing object, missing policy, unknown domain, a positional call read as a policy kind) carries its own wording. Converted 1:1 from features/PolicyReferencesTest (now retired).
